## New public instance collection

Source/release:

Proposal issue:

### Required evidence

- [ ] The complete applicable source release is included or immutably retrievable.
- [ ] Redistribution license or written permission is recorded.
- [ ] Original authors, DOI/URL, citations, and notices are preserved.
- [ ] Every source and normalized artifact has a SHA-256 checksum.
- [ ] Every instance has a schema-valid manifest and stable ID.
- [ ] Derived fields have deterministic code, parameters, seed, and parent lineage.
- [ ] `base_reveal_time` is distinct from physical pickup availability.
- [ ] Problem family and benchmark tier are correctly labeled.
- [ ] Sensitive-data/privacy review is documented.
- [ ] Tests cover counts, checksums, IDs, and temporal consistency.
